r: The Cybersecurity Engineer has primary responsibility for technical execution / delivery of security solutions to customers. While executing a Schneider Electric security solution, the CE will represent Schneider Electric as a technical leader with the proficiency to implement technical security solutions. Solutions will be composed of key elements that meet the customer needs. The CE will manage the implementation of solutions, perform site visits to maintain the security solution, provide security training and consult on security matters when required. The CE will ensure that the security infrastructure required to support Schneider Electric applications is in place. The CE may also function as a requirements analyst and serve as the conduit between the customer and the Schneider Electric Delivery Organization.

The CE will be required to evaluate existing and new technologies to determine their applicability and value for inclusion in the Schneider Electric security solutions, and communicate his or her thoughts to the UAE Cybersecurity Operations Manager or the Global Cybersecurity Director.
Work with the product manager or project sponsor to successfully implement the Schneider Electric Security solutions and associated applications
Configuration of any approved host and network security solutions
Configuration of Network Performance Monitoring and Management solutions
Oversee any required modification or reconfiguration of network elements
Manage installation and connectivity testing of the security solutions
Lead application acceptance testing (from a security perspective)
Develop and deliver end user training
Develop and deliver technical documentation as required
Technical research to meet security solution requirement
5+ years of experience in OT Industrial Control System
3+ years performing the installation and/or management of network-based firewalls, preferably Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper or another top-tier product.
3+ years performing network troubleshooting using sniffers and monitors.
3+ years performing the installation and/or management of network-based Intrusion Detection products.
3+ years advanced systems administration (Windows Active Directory)
3+ years of experience in implementing Host-based security technologies (Antivirus, Data Leakage Prevention, Host IPS, Whitelisting)
3+ years of experience in implementing system backup technologies
Experience working in a mixed environment of both standard TCP/IP and nonstandard networking protocols
Experience in developing, evaluating, implementing Security Policy and Procedures
Experience with the Schneider Electric product line and Industries is desirable but not essential
Experience with LAN, WAN and technologies
Facilitation skills to lead requirements discovery workshops and project scope change requirements

Interpersonal skills, to help negotiate customer priorities and to resolve conflicts among project stakeholders

d: Anton Oilfield Services Group is a globally leading independent integrated oilfield technology services company, operating across major oil and gas production regions worldwide. The business covers oilfield technical services, oilfield management services, oil and gas development operations, natural gas utilization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform collaboration. Anton Group employs approximately 7,000 staff from over 30 countries and regions. Anton’s long-term goal is to become a world-leading green energy technical services company, growing together with its clients and talent to promote high-quality development in the energy industry.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering or a related discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in electrical maintenance within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Industrial sector.
Minimum 4 years of experience working in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or similar utility facilities.
Strong experience maintaining electrical equipment, substations, transformers, switchgear, and distribution panels.
Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for asset and maintenance management.
Strong knowledge of preventive maintenance planning, fault diagnosis, and equipment reliability.
Ability to troubleshoot electrical control systems, electronic circuits, microprocessor-based equipment, and protection systems.
Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Good understanding of electrical safety standards, permit-to-work systems, and maintenance best practices.
r: Perform and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical systems and equipment.
Inspect, test, troubleshoot, and repair electrical equipment, protection systems, substations, transformers, and distribution panels.
Diagnose electrical faults using testing and analytical instruments and recommend system improvements.
Develop and maintain equipment data, preventive maintenance records, and asset information within a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
Plan preventive maintenance activities, including manpower, materials, tools, and spare parts requirements.
Prepare maintenance reports, shutdown analyses, failure investigations, and corrective maintenance reports.
Operate and maintain high- and low-voltage electrical distribution networks in accordance with operational procedures.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety regulations, permit-to-work requirements, and safe work practices.
Provide technical guidance, supervise maintenance personnel, and support on-the-job training.
Participate in emergency call-out duties and support continuous improvement of electrical maintenance activities.

d: We are seeking a qualified and experienced Operating Room (OR) Nurse to provide safe, high-quality nursing care to patients undergoing surgical procedures. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing the operating room, assisting the surgical team, maintaining a sterile environment, and ensuring patient safety throughout the perioperative process.
q: Valid Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS)
Proven clinical experience in an operating room or perioperative nursing setting.
Strong knowledge of surgical procedures, sterile techniques, infection prevention, and patient safety standards.
Familiarity with surgical instruments, operating room equipment, and perioperative protocols.
Ability to recognize and respond effectively to clinical emergencies.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary surgical team.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and safety.
r: Prepare and organize the operating room, ensuring all surgical instruments, equipment, and supplies are available and functioning properly.
Assess patients' preoperative needs and verify patient identity, surgical procedures, consent forms, and relevant medical records.
Assist surgeons and other members of the surgical team during procedures as required.
Perform scrub and circulating nurse duties in accordance with established clinical protocols.
Maintain strict aseptic techniques and ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards.
Monitor patients' conditions before, during, and after surgical procedures, in coordination with the anesthesia and surgical teams.
Perform surgical instrument, sponge, and needle counts in accordance with established safety protocols.
Ensure the proper handling, labeling, and transfer of surgical specimens.
Prepare patients for surgery and provide appropriate nursing care during the perioperative period.
Recognize and respond promptly to emergencies and changes in patients' conditions.
Document nursing assessments, interventions, and surgical procedures accurately in patients' medical records.
Ensure proper cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, and storage of surgical instruments and equipment in coordination with the relevant departments.
Collaborate effectively with surgeons, anesthesiologists, and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe and efficient surgical care.
Comply with hospital policies, clinical guidelines, patient safety requirements, and applicable healthcare regulations.
